title: CDS Special Biryani Masala
description: A fragrant homemade biryani masala with balanced warmth, subtle smokiness, and a rich aroma from green cardamom, black pepper, and whole spices.
steps: Heat a heavy-bottomed pan over low heat.

Dry roast the coriander seeds, cumin seeds, shahi jeera, green cardamom, black cardamom, cinnamon, black peppercorns, dried Kashmiri red chilies, bay leaves, cloves, and mace for 4–6 minutes until fragrant. Stir continuously to avoid burning.
Add the Kasoori methi during the final 30 seconds of roasting.
Transfer the spices to a plate and allow them to cool completely.
Grind the roasted spices with the grated nutmeg, turmeric powder, and salt until very fine.
Store in an airtight glass jar away from heat, light, and moisture.
notes: Using only two black cardamom pods keeps the smoky flavor subtle rather than overpowering.
Freshly grated nutmeg makes a noticeable difference compared to pre-ground.
Grind the masala as finely as possible for smooth restaurant-style gravies and biryanis.
Use about 2–3 tablespoons per kilogram of chicken, lamb, paneer, or vegetables.
